decision_text: I reject commit 7a3a5cfed860f4b15c2ceee9225364fcf8ff520e as completion of Work Order P1. It correctly restored the core guided-minus-unguided and guided-minus-baseline estimands and the two campaign gates, but it is not scientifically or governance-ready. B_max=100 and the scenario model were not operator- or science-review-approved; selected B=24 failed the draft's boundary-null calibration requirement; the t-critical approximation was invalid at small degrees of freedom; and required protocol clauses and conformance checks remained incomplete. I authorize only the protocol-only P1-RESTART described in this work order. This does not authorize simulation, P2, model or benchmark access, token expenditure, pushing, or remote-branch creation.
